title: oxytropis hudsonica
intro: Oxytropis hudsonica, commonly known as Hudson's milkvetch, is a perennial legume native to the northern regions of North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, due to its health benefits. The plant has been found to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Oxytropis hudsonica include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
